item.text: {"confident":true,"explanation":"Instability is the failure of stability: there is a fixed neighborhood that some trajectories leave even when their initial conditions are arbitrarily close to the equilibrium.","answers":[{"key":"selection","correct_option":"c","correct_value":"Some solutions starting arbitrarily close to the equilibrium eventually leave a fixed neighborhood of it.","value_type":"text","wrong_value":"Solutions that start close to the equilibrium remain close to it for all future times, but may not converge to it.","correct_keys":[],"wrong_keys":[]}]}
